selection_rationale: Paired per-fold comparison, simplest first; a more complex family must beat the incumbent by more than the std of the per-fold gap. lightgbm vs logistic_regression: -0.0112 +/- 0.0055 per fold [-0.0124, -0.0178, -0.001, -0.0121, -0.0127] -> keep logistic_regression. Selected logistic_regression. Features: 16 of 18 raw after selection.
notes: Feature selection: work/feature_selection.py -> outputs/model/feature_selection.json (rule 'mean', redundancy removed []). Winner's validation-fold predictions: outputs/model/cv_predictions.parquet (for choosing a threshold without test). Winner CV: pr_auc 0.6747, log_loss 0.4169. Test split not used.
